title: Chapter 797
text:
The appearance of EsGod shocked Murraky. He originally thought that this was just a routine clean-up, but he did not expect EsGod's main body to appear here.

There was a consensus in the Central Galaxy that if one encountered EsGod's main body, it would be best to escape immediately. However, thinking that he had three Beyond Grade As under his command, Murraky suppressed his desire to retreat immediately and wanted to fight.

"You guys stop EsGod and lure him away. Buy some time!"

Murraky ordered the fleet to speed up the attack on the Fallen Ark fleet regardless of the losses. On the other hand, he decisively ordered Han Xiao and the others.

EsGod's ferocity was too deeply rooted in the Central Galaxy. Although Murraky was arrogant, he knew that it was impossible for him to kill EsGod with just his few people. His goal was to destroy the enemy fleet, cut off EsGod's wings, and try to force EsGod's main body back. If he succeeded, it would be a dazzling achievement!

Although EsGod was one of the top Beyond Grade As, he had three people of the same level on his side after all. It was time for him to use them as tools.

The dynasty's troops began to move, but in the sky of the desolate planet, Han Xiao's trio and EsGod were facing each other. They turned a deaf ear to Murraky's words and ignored him.

The atmosphere was almost frozen, and the murderous intent continued to rise.

Beyoni did not dare look away from EsGod. He glanced at Han Xiao in surprise. EsGod had said it out loud, and he had heard it too.

What reply? Black Star and EsGod have private connections?

Han Xiao's fingers moved quickly, and the Mech Legion's cannons all aimed at EsGod. However, he did not attack immediately and slowly spoke.

"Do you really think I'll agree to your conditions and give you the Evolution Cube? Since I've joined the dynasty, you and I are enemies. The reason I'm here to deal with you is to make you give up. The Evolution Cube is with me. If you want it, come and snatch it! "Han Xiao did not hide the fact that the two of them had contacted each other in private and took the initiative to state his stand.

EsGod narrowed his eyes and stared at Han Xiao's neck as if he could see through the mechanical suit and see the Evolution Cube on his neck.

Knowing that he was the one who released the signal this time, he actually dared to come and reject him personally. He brought the Evolution Cube with him just to draw the line. Was he really not afraid that he would steal it? Or was he too confident in his own strength?

EsGod glanced at Han Xiao's trio and said indifferently, "Did the three of us give you the confidence?"

As soon as he said that, EsGod made his move. With a push of his hand, rainbow-like energy gushed out, turning into countless rays of light that shot toward the three of them.

"Shield!"

A green light flashed in Ames' eyes, and a thick force field turned into a shield that covered the three of them. Streaks of rainbow energy exploded on the shield, and the penetrative power was extremely strong. It also had the attribute of disintegration. If it were not for Ames' force field, it would have been difficult to block this attack.

EsGod twisted his palm, and suddenly, another force field descended and squeezed.

"He also has a Force Field Esper Ability." Ames was shocked and hurriedly supported her own force field. The two force fields, one internal and one external, were in a stalemate for a while. They were the ones who were wrapped in EsGod's force field instead.

Force Field Esper Abilities were very common and did not have high potential. Ames was the only one who had cultivated it to Beyond Grade A, but the low-grade Esper Abilities that EsGod absorbed would be enhanced by him to Beyond Grade A, so the two of them were on par.

With a thought, the mechanical army outside immediately launched an attack. EsGod's eyelids drooped, and the space around him suddenly solidified as though it had turned into a crystal structure. The countless psionic cannons were all deflected. Some of them disappeared into the sky, and some of them exploded on the ground. However, none of them hit EsGod's body!

"Pure Energy Refraction Esper Ability …" Han Xiao's expression changed.

At this time, Beyoni released his ability from afar and ignited EsGod's body. Be it his flesh, bones, or energy, they all turned into fuel.

However, EsGod was not affected at all. He took a deep breath, and the flames on his body seemed to be absorbed by his skin. Beyoni's ability turned into pure energy and was devoured by his cells.

Before the few of them could react, half of EsGod's body suddenly turned into black fog, and the black fog condensed into a human figure. Like cells splitting, a new doppelganger was formed.

Swoosh!

This doppelganger disappeared instantly, ignoring Ames's force field, and appeared right in front of Beyoni. It punched toward his chest and activated his [Seraphic Speed] Esper Ability.

Beyoni's reaction was extremely fast. Energy flowed through his arms, and he raised his hands to block the EsGod doppelganger's fist. However, the fist did not have any strength, and the moment it touched Beyoni, a strange energy entered Beyoni's body.

"What …" Beyoni's expression changed drastically. At this moment, he felt as if the Esper Ability in his body had disappeared, and he could not even feel his energy.

At this time, this EsGod doppelganger shone brightly and rapidly expanded.

Buzz!

A black ball of light was born and rapidly expanded. It was as if a black hole had appeared on the surface of the earth, swallowing Beyoni's figure. A portion of the surrounding Mech Army was swallowed and destroyed. The mechanical soldiers that were not at the center of the explosion hurriedly retreated and were blown away by the shockwave.

Boom! The ball of light expanded and exploded, leaving a crater in the ground.

A black fireball floated in the air, and the surrounding black flames dissipated, revealing Beyoni's figure.

He was in a sorry state at this time, and his entire body was charred black. His ability was suppressed by some kind of EsGod Esper Ability. When the doppelganger exploded, it was not easy for him to sense his Esper Ability again. He ignited the energy nearby and blocked most of the power of the explosion, creating a blank space around him. That was why he was not severely injured.

Not far away, the space rippled slightly, and Han Xiao walked out. He avoided the explosion through Void Hyperdrive. On the other side, Ames also walked out of the Void Dimension. She had used the same method to avoid the center of the explosion as Han Xiao.

After a short exchange, the three of them looked up at EsGod, who did not move at all.

"What a terrifying fellow …"

Although he had expected this, EsGod's strength still shocked Han Xiaoxin. Rumors were one thing, but facing EsGod in person was another. The main body and doppelganger were two completely different concepts.

In front of him was a monster who had spent countless years collecting Arcanas, and who knew how many abilities he had!

This guy's main body was the true meaning of 'EsGod' — the omnipotent god of Esper Abilities!

The potential of an Esper Ability limited the upper limit of the user's Grade. Many unique Esper Abilities had very low upper limits, but after EsGod absorbed these Esper Abilities, he used his own Beyond Grade A attributes as the source of power, allowing many Esper Abilities that could not be upgraded to the Beyond Grade A level. No matter how simple an Esper Ability was, it would still be extremely powerful in his hands.

For example, the ability to suppress Beyoni used a type of Esper Ability to silence others. This ability had a very low upper limit and would not even work on Calamity Grades. However, with EsGod's own strength, even Beyond Grade As would not be immune to it.

With so many Esper Abilities, EsGod had almost no shortcomings. To him, the two biggest limitations were his own energy limit, and he could not use too many Esper Abilities at the same time, which would put a huge burden on his genetic chain.

He could suppress three people with ease. In the entire universe, there were not many who could be his match in a direct confrontation!

"Luckily, Beyoni is here as well. If there were only two Beyond Grade As, we would be in a very passive position. Although the three of us can't beat him, we can at least hold him back …" Han Xiaoxin's expression was solemn as he reorganized the scattered Mech Legion.

Compared to the few Beyond Grade As he had fought before, EsGod was the only one who had overwhelming combat strength. The pressure he gave him was unprecedentedly huge!

"As expected of the Brutes whose name has spread across the entire galaxy." Ames took a deep breath with a serious expression. This was also her first time fighting EsGod, and it was her first time personally experiencing EsGod's terrifying combat strength. She was shocked.

EsGod glanced at the three of them and suddenly disappeared in front of them with a teleport.

"Not good."

Han Xiao raised his head, and his expression changed. EsGod had suddenly moved into the middle of the dynasty's fleet.

Murraky, who was commanding the fleet, also had the same thought. When he saw EsGod appear in the fleet, his expression changed drastically.

The next moment, EsGod punched out, and a black and red beam of light shot toward the Guardian Grade flagship. It instantly penetrated the high-energy shield of the flagship and created a huge hole in the hull. The hole penetrated from the front to the back, and armor fragments flew everywhere.

"Warning! Warning! Hull damaged by 10.8%! Engine No. 3 damaged! Energy transmission circuit damaged. Energy core output efficiency reduced by 18%. Repairing … "

The vibration of the hull caused the people in the command room to stagger and almost fall to the ground. Murraky finally stabilized himself, but he was already shocked.

"Retreat quickly!"

The main ship was attacked, and the situation had suddenly changed. If EsGod hit him a few more times, he would be dead for sure. The unwillingness in Murraky's heart disappeared instantly, and he did not dare fight anymore.

However, EsGod's target was the main ship, and he shot out a series of black and red light beams.

Looking at the attack approaching from the porthole and listening to the alarm of the spaceship, Murraky suddenly realized that he was powerless in front of such power. The fleet he trusted could not save him at all. He was like a lamb waiting to be slaughtered.

A look of despair appeared on his face.

The light beam shot into the main ship. The next moment, the interior of the ship expanded, and the main ship exploded.

Murraky's vision turned black, and he closed his eyes to wait for death. Suddenly, he felt cold metal wrap around his body. He opened his eyes immediately and saw the explosion of the main ship getting further and further away. He was covered by a mechanical suit and was quickly moving away from the explosion area.

"I'm not dead!" Murraky's eyes were wide open, and his heart was still palpitating.

At this time, the tactical screen lit up, and Han Xiao's face appeared.

"You're still alive? Don't just stand there. The fleet needs your command. Don't think about retreating. Although EsGod is terrifyingly strong, he won't be able to defeat three Beyond Grade As in a short time. This place is very close to the dynasty's border, and the border guard army can come and help at any time. He won't stay here for too long. As long as we hold on, we can force him to retreat. "

When the main ship exploded, Han Xiao had arrived and saved Murraky. This guy could not die yet. The fleet needed a command.

Black Star? This guy saved me?

Murraky's expression changed. After hearing Han Xiao's words, he clenched his teeth and gave up on the idea of retreating. He hurriedly opened the command channel and ordered the fleet to continue attacking. The mechanical suit on his body protected him from being decapitated.

Han Xiao led the two of them to surround EsGod again, using all their strength to drag him away from the battlefield of the fleet.

The four of them fought fiercely. EsGod dealt with the attacks of the three of them without showing any signs of difficulty. Instead, the wounds on Han Xiao's group kept increasing, and the casualties of the Mech Legion also gradually increased. They were not EsGod's match one on one, so they could only cooperate with each other. It felt like three heroes fighting against Lu Bu.

In the midst of the fierce battle, Han Xiao suddenly received a telepathic message from EsGod.

"I've always been curious. How did you know how to use the Evolution Cube?" EsGod's tone was curious.

He was truly confused. The information of the Evolutionary Civilization was clearly in his hands. He had checked Han Xiao's background, and he had never interacted with the Evolutionary Civilization before this. How did he know how to use the Evolution Cube?

Han Xiao blocked an energy blast from an unknown Esper Ability with his psionic shield. His whole body stiffened, and he clenched his teeth and barely opened his mouth. "I … was lucky!"

"Lucky? Do you think I'm that easy to fool? "EsGod had a look of disbelief.

The password to open the Evolution Cube is so complicated. If you were to rely on luck, the probability is infinitely close to zero. Who are you trying to fool?

There is only one possibility. The information of the Evolutionary Civilization must have been leaked from somewhere.

After pausing for a while, EsGod dodged a force field attack from Ames and suddenly shook his head. "Forget it. The main point is that you know how to use it. The reason doesn't matter. This might have given you confidence, but it's a pity that you underestimated me and overestimated yourself. Bringing the portable Evolution Cube to me is your biggest mistake."

This time, EsGod raised his palm, and a blue light ball floated in his palm. The next moment, the light ball suddenly disappeared and turned into a familiar silver cube.

Han Xiao's body trembled, and he hurriedly looked down. The Evolution Cube on his neck had disappeared, and there was no sound at all when it disappeared!
